greeting: Welcome back to Release Radar, where we track the WordPress plugin universe so you don't have to!
introParagraph: This week, the plugin landscape saw a healthy mix of significant feature rollouts and crucial bug fixes, ensuring our favorite tools are not just getting more powerful but also more robust. Accessibility was a major theme, alongside some exciting checkout and AI innovations that promise to streamline workflows and boost conversions. Let's dive into what's new and noteworthy!

highlights.title: Easy Digital Downloads 3.7.0
highlights.summary: EDD just leveled up its checkout game! With new block editor support for customization and composable Elementor widgets, you now have finer-grained control over your checkout experience, promising a smoother purchase journey for your customers.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Instagram Feed 6.12.0
highlights.summary: Huge applause for Smash Balloon! This release brings significant accessibility improvements, making the Instagram feed builder and your actual feeds much easier to use for everyone, including those relying on keyboards and screen readers. Inclusivity wins!

highlights.title: Envira Gallery Lite 1.15.0
highlights.summary: Get ready for a glimpse into the future with Envira Gallery Lite, which now includes an AI Image Assistant preview directly in the gallery editor. This could be a game-changer for streamlining image management and enhancement within your galleries.

highlights.title: OptinMonster 2.17.0
highlights.summary: OptinMonster has bumped its minimum supported PHP and WordPress versions, ensuring better performance and security moving forward. This update also squashes a fatal error on PHP 8.0+ during campaign sync, keeping your lead generation humming along nicely.
